title: Annotatio III §.I: Landgrave brings both parties to Marburg 1529 — Universal Consensus except the Article on the Lord’s Supper
pass_a_gloss: By all which the Landgrave at last brought it about that the Theologians of both parties should travel out to him at Marburg, and, he being present, in the year 1529 enter into a Universal Consensus, with one Article excepted — that on the Lord’s Supper.
pass_b_english: By all of this the Landgrave at last got the theologians of both sides to come out to him at Marburg, and there in 1529, with him present, they entered a Universal Consensus — one article excepted: the Lord’s Supper.
source_text: Quibus omnibus Landgravius tandem effecit, ut Marpurgum ad se excurrerent Theologi utriusque partis, seque praesente, anno 1529. Consensum Universalem, uno excepto de Coena Domini Articulo, inirent.

lemmas.latin: Marpurgum ad se excurrerent Theologi utriusque partis

lemmas.gloss: Universal Consensus, one Article excepted — on the Lord’s Supper
